title: Repository path classification
responsibility: Determines a file’s owning workspace and whether it belongs to the registry, ignored files, global inputs, tests, source or other files.

inputs.name: classifyPath.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative path using forward slashes, to compare with workspace roots and configured patterns.

inputs.name: classifyPath.config
inputs.description: Workspace roots and ignored, global and test patterns used for classification.

outputs.name: classifyPath
outputs.description: Classification, workspace name and root, workspace-relative path, and source identity when recognized. The deepest matching workspace wins; registry, ignored, global, test and source checks run in that order.
